line_items.reasoning: Q2 worldwide sales grew 6.6% operationally, with Innovative Medicine posting a record $14.5B quarter, clearly exceeding the full-year operational sales growth guidance range of 5.5%-6.0% on a quarterly basis and prompting a further raise to full-year guidance.

Adjusted operational EPS guidance was raised by an additional $0.05/share (implying 8.2% YoY growth at midpoint) before acquisition dilution, surpassing the prior midpoint of $10.68 and indicating Q2 results came in ahead of the guided trajectory.
No specific update was provided on interest income relative to the prior $550M-$650M guidance range, suggesting results were roughly in line with expectations.

The combined Shockwave, Proteologix, and NM26 acquisitions created $0.68/share of EPS dilution in 2024, far exceeding the originally guided ~$0.10 dilution from Shockwave alone, and adjusted pretax operating margin guidance flipped from +50 bps improvement to a -120 bps decline.
